summary: Master CBDC design, SupTech oversight, and payment modernization. Join our expert-led course for central bank professionals.
lede: FinTech training for central-bank professionals covers how digital finance affects oversight, payments and financial stability. Policy analysts, financial-stability officers and payment-system managers can learn to assess CBDC design, modernize payment and settlement systems, use SupTech for supervisory reporting, and evaluate distributed-ledger applications, open-banking risks and cyber resilience.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals tasked with maintaining the integrity and modernization of national financial systems in an era of digital disruption.
modules: FinTech Ecosystem and Central Bank Mandates
Data Analytics and Financial Stability Indicators
DLT and Blockchain in Financial Infrastructure
prerequisites: Participants should have a minimum of 3-5 years of experience in central banking, financial regulation, or payment systems. A foundational understanding of monetary policy and financial market infrastructure is required. No prior programming or technical coding skills are necessary, but familiarity with basic data analysis concepts is recommended.
